A Game About Picking Fruits
games.summary: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

games.name: Abashed
games.summary:
Abashed is a 2.5D narrative-driven side-scrolling game that lets you explore the life of Issac, a man living with psychosis. One day waking up all alone, he sets out to find the truth behind his missing partner. On the way he finds himself needing to confront his deepest fears and the darkest secrets. 

Join Issac in this story of love, loss, fear, and acceptance. Reality is not what it seems.

games.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle

A pleasant voice in the game, in either Swedish or English, asks where a specific item is on the game board and it's up to your child to point out the correct item. Each item has an exciting sound to listen at.You can also create customized cards with your own pictures, sounds and effects and use them directly in the game! This allows you to create a personal card collection of personal everyday items from your home, in a language of your own choice.Features:- Card pack with 150 cards picturing everyday items - Voices in Swedish and English for all cards- Make your own cards from your home enviroment with  unique pictures and sounds IN WHATEVER LANGUAGE YOU LIKE- Different gameboard sizes- Random or custom play- And more!A real fun way of learning new words for your child!If you like this game please leave a review and try the second game in the series, My First Words -learn 150 things to do. ****User Stories from the My First Words series****“The pictures are beautiful, the sound effects are great and the music and voices are of high quality. games.name: Artifact Tracer
games.summary: One artifact, two mysteries: when and where? Artifact Tracer is a visual deduction game about Chinese artifacts. Trace 1,000+ real artifacts across map and timeline, unlock your Archive, and compete in Daily Challenges.

games.name: Axomorph Idle
games.summary: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, evolve, rebirth, and ascension stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

games.name: Backmarkers: A Racing Management Sim
games.summary: Take over the worst team on the grid and run all of it — drivers, sponsors, the garage, every pit call. Climb a living three-tier racing pyramid where rivals rise and fall around you, in a broadcast-style management sim that remembers every result.

games.name: Battle Bears Gold - Bling Pack: Weapon, Rare Songs & Gas
Battle Bears Gold - Classic Skins & Jukebox Songs
Battle Bears Gold - Gold Skins Pack
Battle Bears Gold - Overclock Skins, Weapons & Jukebox Song
Block Guy
games.summary: Block Guys, giant walking war machines built from colored blocks, are marching on your base. Slide their blocks with the mouse, line up three or more of a color to clear them, and drop the Bloquians riding on top to the ground. Call in fire from your base and pop PSI balloons for special powers.

games.name: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing
games.summary: STMemory (Short Term Memory)How about your Short Term Memory?Tap the number of display!A large number of digits, you get high scores.Let's take a look at the rankings!

games.name: Bone Breaker
games.summary: In this 2D platformer, through 4 different worlds. Face a gauntlet of 17 different boss fight. Beat them all and face your future. The golden crown awaits.

games.name: Bush League Baseball
games.summary: **BE A ZOMBIE!** TRANSFORM YOURSELF INTO A WALKER! "A must have app for Walking Dead fans." THE DEAD Now you can use existing photos or take new ones and then transform yourself and friends into zombies! Walkers, biters, zombies, dead, brains, and more! Includes multiple zombie options, faces, parts, bodies, bonus props, signs, and more! Have a great time making your own zombie creations. Turn your co-workers and family members into zombies! Easy to use and save your creations to your camera roll and email them and post to Facebook. Zombie sound effects are also included for more fun! BE A ZOMBIE TODAY!

games.name: Cabezurrio vs Skeletons
games.summary: In a world dominated by skeletons, Cabezurrio is the only hope for restoring things to how they once were. Armed only with a suit of armor, a shield, and a sword—and aided by a wizard—he will attempt to wipe out all the skeletons and set his companions free.

games.name: Caesar: The Gallic Campaign
games.summary: 58 BC. You are a nameless ranker of Rome's Tenth Legion, crossing eight years of Caesar's Gallic campaign at spear height. No turns: one click is your movement and your strike. Build out of affixes and runes, hunt the titled elites, and see eight chapters through to the epilogue.

games.name: Camera 5
games.summary: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

games.name: Compactor Baron
games.summary: You're broke and the bills keep coming. Smash scrap into cubes, sell them, pay up. A short active incremental: aim, let the hammer swing, upgrade your tools, go bankrupt on purpose, and build a scrapyard that pays for itself.

games.name: Covering the Sky: The Path to Emperorship
games.summary: 《遮天：帝路争锋》是一款获得《遮天》动画正版授权的群像修仙游戏，游戏基于辰东所著网络小说《遮天》的背景设定。

games.name: CRYMELIGHT
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Cubus Tower
games.summary: Cubus tower is a platformer game. Climb the Cubus tower and find what is waiting for you at its summit.

games.name: Desktop Slime Graveyard: Tap Reaper
games.summary: Race the fun Tiny Critter friends in over 20 challenging levels.Challenge your friends and family and collect all the cute tiny critters!

games.name: Deuce Agency 2027
games.summary: Run a tennis agency, not a player. Scout unknown juniors, negotiate contracts and sponsorships, plan every player's season across a 52-week world tour, and give tactical orders between sets — a deep management sim built on how professional tennis really makes money.

games.name: Dialshift
games.summary: This App is suitable for children 2 to 6 years old.This app takes your child on a journey through the zoo.Learn to count, learn the alphabet and have fun at the same time. By connecting the dots in the correct order, your child will learn in a fun way. When the puzzle is solved, the silhouette changes and reveals an animal.? 12 free scenes? Learn to count, learn the alphabet and have fun at the same time? Elaborately drawn animals? Background music (can be muted)? Two game modes (Numbers and Letters)

games.name: Digging Up Together
games.summary: Dig up the Egyptian desert. Sweep with a metal detector, shovel and drill through the layers in 1–4 player co-op, brush off ancient treasures and real-size dinosaur bones, haul them home by wheelbarrow or minecart, and build your own museum.

games.name: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
games.summary: FAST. FUN. CRICKET! Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket Jr is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: FailRooms
games.summary: Failrooms is a first-person exploration game that parodies liminal spaces. Delve into photorealistic environments where the terror of the unknown collides with the most incompetent architecture imaginable. Can you survive this dimensional prank without losing your mind?

games.name: Find The Box
games.summary: A slow, quiet first-person digging game. One million blocks, one box to find. Normal mode gives you a warmer/colder signal as you approach the box; Hard mode gives you nothing. Every hole you dig is saved, a clock tracks your run, and your best times are kept. No enemies, no pressure. Just dig.

games.name: Floorball Manager
games.summary: Take charge of a floorball club in 8 nations. Scout talent, build your lines and watch every shift on an animated rink. Chase titles, the Continental Cup and national-team glory or rebuild the world your way with the full editor.

games.name: Football Star Life ! 26/27
games.summary: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

games.name: Goninkan
games.summary: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

games.name: Good Boy, Good Girl!
games.summary: Train your loyal dog to fetch balls and frisbees across challenging parks, but watch out for wild dogs trying to disrupt your fun! Clear every park to reach the ultimate finale at the sunny beach.

games.name: Grandma Left Me A Building - Prologue
Heroes & Co.
games.summary: Hire the worst misfits in town and form the perfect team to face every disaster. Your mission? Survive one full week. Get ready for seven days of cascading emergencies, exhausted heroes, and impossible choices to save the day.

games.name: High Lance
games.summary: Tap to flap. Higher lance wins. A one-button arcade game: ride a griffin over an endless world of floating ledges, unseat rival riders from above, and catch them as they parachute down to build a capture streak. Miss them, and they'll return a rank tougher. Five lands, each ending with a dragon.

games.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay - Supporter Pack
I Hate Scalpers
games.summary: I just hate scalpers. So I made a game about bonking them so they don't come back! Figure out who the scalpers and sitters are and BONK THEM! Duel people in Cut The Line and be the hero the city.

games.name: IMYEON : Yokai Survivor
games.summary: A pixel-art survivors game where you fight swarms of yokai with old Korean weapons and shaman tools like the Horn Bow and Spirit Knives. Pick an upgrade on every level-up and fuse two maxed weapons into one. 6 stages, a 30-minute Endless mode, 20 heroes and 12 fusion weapons.

games.name: just volleyball
games.summary: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

games.name: Kamikaze Aliens
games.summary: Welcome to Kamikaze Aliens, a game with no big bosses or awe-inspiring enemies—just you, your ship, and an endless horde of aliens spawned from randomized spawners that will make you see stars at the slightest touch!

games.name: Lazy Cat - Mini Game Collection
games.summary: Take a cosy break with cute cats and 14 mini-games, from classic puzzles and solitaire to arcade favourites. Enjoy charming stylised visuals, relaxing music, and day and night themes. Pick a game, settle in, and let the everyday rush fade away.

games.name: Lightyear Frontier
games.summary:
Lightyear Frontier is an open-world farming exploration game with crafting, resource management and base building, wrapped in a mystery-driven narrative with a cosmic country soundtrack.

Play 1-4 players in online co-op, discover and grow alien plants, domesticate wildlife, endure the elements and build your new home away from home.

games.name: Lucky Shot VR
games.summary: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot VR is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

games.name: Magic Clicker
games.summary: Blast through hordes with magic and grow wildly powerful! Play as Shiina in a mix of 3D action and clicker progression. Defeat enemies to upgrade and awaken spells, from Magic Ball to Laser Beam. Use Rebirth to grow stronger, and reach new heights of power with your little dragon companion!

games.name: Make it! Karaage
games.summary: Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge! Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!

games.name: Mancalero
games.summary: Mancalero is a marble board game fusing roguelike progression with deckbuilder strategy. Collect special marbles, unlock powerful Blessings, and defeat every table to become the true Mancalero.

games.name: Marble Stars
games.summary: Marble Stars is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you roll, jump, and race through 55 levels of different difficulties, using special abilities along the way. Master each course, chase your best times, and earn medals as you improve.

games.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
games.summary: A cozy sudoku game for the end of the day, with a cat for company. Play thousands of hand-graded puzzles offline, or solve the Nightly — one shared puzzle a day, every day. Pick a lofi station, layer rain over it, and settle in. Every board is solvable by logic alone; not one needs a guess.

games.name: My Name Is Vincent Pogo Demo
Neuroflip
games.summary: A card-based memory roguelike. Flip cards, remember where each face appeared and match pairs to defeat the Scribe, the Lady and the King. Missing on a new card is free; forgetting a pair you've already seen can cost you dearly.

games.name: Nine Provinces
games.summary: Play the popular game My Sweet Dog by Mary.com on your phone and tablet computer. In the first level of this game, you'll be taking care of a playful puppy called Frodo. You learn what is important in the life of such a small pup. Because a dog can easily be your companion for 10 to 15 years, it's important to bring it up right. Give him food and water. Play with him and take him out for walks. Wash him and make sure he gets enough sleep. If you do well, your puppy will grow into a lovely, happy and healthy dog. In the next level you will be able to train him and win competitions with him. In the third level, he's too old for competing, and you will take it easier. If you do well, you'll win photos of your dog! The better you do, the more photos you will earn. In this game you'll learn a lot about dogs. It takes a lot of time to raise and to take care of dogs, but if you do it well, they will be true, loyal friends. In the accompanying film, you can see how the game works.

games.name: Nozile
games.summary: Catch and throw Javelin repeatedly! Calculate the angle to fire!

games.name: Objecipher
games.summary: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

games.name: Offworlders: Galactic Ventures
games.summary: Top-down space trading and combat on a working frontier. Run cargo, hunt salvage, fight pirates, and build a corporation that survives twenty cycles of pressure from the Cryos Foundation, the Frontier Allegiance, and the Sable Syndicate.

games.name: Old Man's Sushi
games.summary: LayerBall is a relaxing billard game for in between. But it's not one of a kind from whom already exists a lot of. It's a modification with an extended game play.Playing LayerBall means not playing on only one table as in a classical billard game. In LayerBall you can play on up to 5 different tables at the same time, each on top of each other.Every table has its own color and only balls of this color are allowed to be pocketed at this particular table.

games.name: Outbreak: Dead City
games.summary: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

games.name: Piratocon: Dig, Restore & Collect
games.summary: A cozy first-person collecting game. Dig lost model ships out of a sunny beach dune, rebuild each one on the shelf of her kind aboard an old galleon and scrub her back to her true colours. No combat, no rush, just sand, sea and a collection that grows a little every day.

games.name: Prigod Idle
games.summary: You've never experienced a running game on iPhone until you experience Fun Caveman Run.This caveman is crazy, and so is the game!

games.name: Project President
games.summary: Run a country under pressure. Pass laws, negotiate Congress, survive scandals, control the media, face protests and win elections in a deep political strategy sim where every decision has consequences.

games.name: Red Glare The Reckoning
games.summary: Red Glare: The Reckoning is a fully standalone experience of Real Time Tactics game Red Glare. You do not need the original Red Glare to play. Whether you're a returning agent or a first-time recruit, this is a complete campaign with its own story.

games.name: Relic Recoil
games.summary: Cute looks. Serious firepower! Explore machine ruins with Ain and Granma in this survivor-style action game. Blast through hordes of machines and bring resources back to base to upgrade your favorite guns, abilities, and support drones. Shape your playstyle and push deeper with every expedition.

games.name: Rustic Furnishings - WorldNeverland - Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom - Another Life Adventure
Souterrain
games.summary: Roll the dice. Cheat fate. Break the house. Souterrain is a roguelike dice-and-card game where you manipulate colorful dice, build powerful combinations, and gamble everything on one more hand.

games.name: Spincremental
games.summary: Pull the lever, watch the reels, collect the symbols. Buy slot machines, unlock cursors, magnets, and cards that play for you, then upgrade everything through a deep skill tree. A cozy pixel-art incremental about turning one wooden slot into an automated jackpot empire.

games.name: Stellar Nursery
games.summary: Reignite a dead sun. Rebuild its worlds. Your only companion is P.O.R.T.I.A., a caretaker AI who has been alone for a very long time, and who remembers more than she should. A story rich idle game about grief, patience, and second chances, told over generations of stars.

games.name: Suixun 01: The Last Customer
games.summary: A linear paranormal mystery visual novel driven by dynamic text presentation. As timid but earnest rookie Mao-Rabbit, explore a mall after closing, rescue a customer the night guard cannot see, and uncover the anomaly rules already at work. No branches or bad endings.

games.name: SUPER GAHAKU
games.summary: Draw in 3D space! Create hilariously wonky sculptures from prompts, then laugh and guess what everyone was trying to make. The worse you are at drawing, the more fun it gets!

games.name: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek
The Smiling Flesh
games.summary: The Smiling Flesh is a tense, single-player survival horror where you play as a thief trapped in a decaying gothic mansion. Solve puzzles, explore forgotten halls, and outsmart a twisted entity that learns your movements. Find the treasure, or become the mansion's next victim.

games.name: The Stolen Dawn
games.summary: The dawn has been stolen! Take it back in a pixel-art action platformer where clever puzzles meet charged bow shots. Journey through eight biomes in Story Mode, or chase your next high score in an ever-changing Endless Mode.

games.name: Tidy Up Me Eggs!
games.summary: 3,888 eggs. One cozy coop. A whole lot of sorting. Tidy up and organize a ridiculous variety of cute, silly, and wonderfully weird eggs. Just be careful what you break… the rooster has something to say about it!

games.name: TinyBriks
games.summary: TinyBriks is a relaxing minimalist plastic brick building game where there are no objectives, no building instructions, no time pressure and no maximizing shareholder value. Make whatever YOU want. Create fantastic dioramas from a plethora of brick styles and colors. Your imagination is the limit.

games.name: Tirade
games.summary: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

games.name: Trolley Dilemma
games.summary: Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

games.name: Village in Bloom
games.summary: Build a new life on Grandpa Rıza’s farm in this cozy, single-player farming adventure. Grow crops, care for animals, fish, cook, craft, and fulfill your neighbors’ letters and orders on the way to the village fair.

games.name: Wardspire
games.summary: Defend the Nine Realms! Wardspire is a Norse tower defense built around a true counter system: 8 towers with 2 specializations each, 17 enemy types with resistances, 9 distinct realms, permanent progression in the Forge, and an endless mode.

games.name: Warlapse
games.summary: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

games.name: Way Too Many Eggs
games.summary: Animated 3D Puzzle Delight from the creators of DreamWorks' Kung-Fu Panda An arcade-puzzle fusion with a touch of adventure - in 3D! Your mission: Help the bird get to its nest safely, survive a series of obstacles as you build the highest tower without knocking it over. And by the way - don’t forget to feed the hungry bird - for extra bonuses and surprises! Toppal Act I “Hungry Bird” is the first game in the Balancin’ Act Series. This long awaited innovative game from the creators of DreamWorks’ Kung Fu Panda and other Hollywood Blockbuster movies, was first introduced as a free-to-play demo in 2011, and quickly grabbed these worldwide ranking:No. 1 App of all apps in 26 CountriesNo. 1 App of all Games Apps in 30 CountriesNo. 1 App Puzzle Category 37 countriesNo. 1 App Family Category 41 countriesFeaturesFreemium with In-App Purchases.  "Unlock All Game Levels" on special premiere discount of $0.99 !!! , and, sooner or later you are going to need those ‘repair blocks’ to keep your ‘skyscraper tower’ from falling... so hit the store (shopping cart) button! Ever wondered why all mobile/tablet games hide a tap or swipe target under your finger exactly when you need to see it most?  Introducing an innovative gameplay which projects your natural hand motion onto an animated 3d hand.Fully animated 3d characters. imagine ‘humanoids worms’ w/ full gestures and facial expressions - going through all this trouble just to end up as ‘bird food’...‘Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle’ gets new life in this next generation 3d physics engine which generates a never-ending unpredictable behavior (though not quite quantum physics and not quite a casual game either...)Save and recall game states into the cloud or your mobile device, will allow you to play intermittently, as well as remember your games forever! So don’t worry if you run into a few bugs or crashes (yap, we have a few), you won’t lose a thing. We promise! (if you wonder why - we never got around to make that delete button…)  Watch it! if you think you are in a racing game, this building blocks game can turn to a demolition game at any moment. Every move you make counts and becomes a new journey...  Facebook integration. You can even download your Facebook picture onto the game (we still not sure what for)3D social/multiplayer.  play with anyone, anywhere (coming soon) Best thing to do if you want to annoy them - completely ignore that they are on a different time zone.Superbly rich graphics environment takes full advantage of our purposely unlocked 3D  camera. You choose where to look! We have styled and localized each of several hundreds of menus and pop-ups for your enjoyment.Say goodbye to good ‘old Jenga or Tetris. What ‘weird hybrid animal’ would you get     when you mix these two?  Time to find out...V.1.0.0 Release NotesiPhone 4/4s players might experience some 'slow-down' behavior as they build the tower higher.  iPhone 3G/3GS, iPod Touch 3rd/4th Generation or older models will run too slow and are NOT recommended. If your game feel "frozen" or looks like a "bug", most likely your device is unable to handle the intensive computations of our 3D Physics. You may exit the game and try again but you will likely to run into bugs.   Know bugs/issues App orientation should always be “Portrait”.  However, iPhone5 orientation is not fully locked and could freeze if you started the game when your device is held in Landscape mode. Workaround: always start the game while holding the device upright or portrait position. (fixed in V1.0.1)  In The Stairs challenge, If your tower automatically reset to the beginning of the challenge (normal behavior) and “Show Tutorial” (in The Option Menu) is on, you may not be able to advance on the stairs. Workaround: avoid going to the option menu while playing the Stairs challenge. (fixed in V1.0.1)

games.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
games.summary: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

games.name: Wickwood
games.summary: A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. The shrinking circle of light is the only clock you get. Find the parts for a dead car and drive out of Wickwood before the light goes.

games.name: Wildixir
games.summary: Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and turn cleansed shrines into healing groves or deadly gardens. Unlock alchemists and confront the bosses of three corrupted lands.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Forever
games.summary:
Azeroth, an untamed frontier begging to be explored. 

Step into World of Warcraft: Forever and quest through an iconic world reimagined with new and expanded zones, new gameplay enhancements, upgraded graphics, and more.

WoW: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.

games.name: WW.Heaven
games.summary: Only the perfect go to heaven. WW.Heaven is a short first-person collectathon where you set out on a quest to fulfill your sister’s dying wish.

games.name: Xenobiome Command
games.summary: A colony survival strategy game on a fungal exoplanet, crossing colony sim, base building and territory control. Survey the fog, claim the ground under it, raise an outpost, and hold the line as the bloom and its ferals close in.

games.name: Zombie BBQ House
games.summary: Zombie BBQ House is an online co-op restaurant sim for 1–8 players. Spot disguised zombies. Butcher, grill, serve. Hit the wrong person, the police come. Burn it, dinner hits back. Made money? Casino's across the street. With friends, someone's always slacking and someone's always causing trouble.

games.name: マジッククリッカー Demo
Cash is King! - The Official Book
Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Cat-Astrophy is a fast-paced Action Roguelite that combines frantic combat, precision platforming and unique builds across procedurally generated planets. Every run offers new ways to play, death is permanent. Can you survive the cat-astrophe?

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Dark Alley
games.summary:
Kyoto, 2013. A British detective vanishes without a trace. London sends Thomas Bennett to close the case quietly. But Kyoto doesn’t do “quiet.” Beneath red lanterns and rain-slicked alleys, Bennett finds a city built on rituals, secrets... and people willing to kill to protect them.

What starts as a missing-person investigation spirals into a dangerous web involving the Dragon Vein Yakuza, a mysterious informant, and a cold institutional presence that watches every step Bennett takes. The deeper you go through nightclubs, temples, bamboo forests and mirrored corridors, the more mystery arise around the case... until the question isn’t who took Hale, but why the truth was never meant to survive.

Dark Alley is a standalone case within the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases saga, a cinematic narrative thriller with psychological tension and dry, noir humor.

games.name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

games.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary:
Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. 

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.

In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the vibes that student life has to offer.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.
